name: canvas-prompt
description: A local thinking canvas for Codex: draw, circle, move, and export the context behind your prompt.

interface.shortDescription: Draw, circle, move, and export the context behind your prompt.
interface.longDescription: Canvas Prompt is a local canvas for the work that happens before a clean chat prompt exists. Draw, circle, move, and explain; export each round as device-local context that Codex can read on explicit request.
